title: Count the Hidden Sequences
summary: Given an array of differences and a range defined by two integers lower and upper, determine the number of possible hidden sequences of length (n + 1) where each element is within the range [lower, upper] and the differences between consecutive elements match the given differences array.
statement: Given an array of differences and a range defined by two integers lower and upper, determine the number of possible hidden sequences of length (n + 1) where each element is within the range [lower, upper] and the differences between consecutive elements match the given differences array. If no such sequences are possible, return 0.
constraints: A hidden sequence has one more value than differences and every value lies inclusively between lower and upper.
Consecutive hidden values differ by the corresponding differences entry.
Return the number of possible integer sequences.
hints: All hidden sequences are translations of the same cumulative-difference prefix sequence.
Find the minimum and maximum relative prefix values; a start must keep both within the allowed range.
Every intermediate prefix lies between the extrema, so satisfying the two extreme bounds is necessary and sufficient.
editorial: Every intermediate prefix lies between the extrema, so satisfying the two extreme bounds is necessary and sufficient.
